Container.Name: vora-postgres
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension - the database backend required by the Vora media server. Put this on the same user-defined Docker network as the Vora container (e.g. "vora") so Vora can reach it by name (vora-postgres). No port is published, keeping the database off your LAN.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_DB
Config.Description: Database name (match the Vora connection string)

Config.Name: POSTGRES_USER
Config.Description: Database user (match the Vora connection string)

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Database password (use a strong value; match the Vora connection string)
